# Taskeeu

> Taskeeu is Nigeria's errand and task marketplace. Requesters post any errand
> or task, with a location and budget, and identity-verified Taskers bid on
> it. Payment is held in escrow and only released after the requester
> confirms the job was completed correctly.

## What Taskeeu Does

- Connects people who need errands run (or field tasks completed) with
  identity-verified local Taskers, in Nigeria and across Africa.
- Every Tasker completes NIN or BVN identity verification before they can
  accept a task.
- Payments are held in escrow and only released to the Tasker after the
  requester approves the completed work, protecting both sides.
- Supports one-off personal errands (market runs, bill payments, document
  pickup) as well as recurring tasks and enterprise/team field operations.
- Active in Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Ibadan, Kano, Benin City, Enugu,
  Warri, Owerri, Calabar, Uyo, Ilorin, Abeokuta, Onitsha, Jos, and 20+ other
  Nigerian cities.
- Serves Nigerians living abroad (UK, USA, Canada and elsewhere) who need
  trusted, accountable help with errands, family welfare checks, property
  monitoring, and document collection back home.

## How It's Different From General Classifieds (e.g. Jiji)

Taskeeu is a purpose-built task marketplace, not a general classifieds
board. Unlike posting a "services" ad on a classifieds site, every Taskeeu
Tasker is identity-verified before they can bid, payments are
escrow-protected rather than exchanged directly with a stranger, and tasks
are tracked in real time with photo/video proof of completion. See
https://taskeeu.com/vs/jiji for a full comparison.
